# Official SHAW 3.03 Trial excerpts

Exact header and first two/final data lines from the USDA-ARS [Shaw303.zip](https://www.ars.usda.gov/ARSUserFiles/20520500/SHAW/303/Shaw303.zip) Trial reference outputs, retrieved 2026-10-01. Line endings are normalized to LF. These are authentic reference values, not generated simulations. The full archive was 14,071,821 bytes.
